changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE bank_transaction_links ADD COLUMN client_proforma_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_bank_transaction_links_client_proforma REFERENCES client_proformas (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ADD COLUMN external_order_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_bank_transaction_links_external_order REFERENCES external_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_links_client_proforma ON bank_transaction_links (client_proforma_id); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_links_external_order ON bank_transaction_links (external_order_id);
